cinematic_dialogue:2:1611330002:.text: By authority of the crown, I declare:
cinematic_dialogue:2:1611330002:.source_cn: 我以王室特使的身份宣布

say:7:1611399002:1.text: I didn't expect to see you here, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Sorry, I'm actually here to see Headmistress Durella.
say:7:1611399002:1.male: I didn't expect to see you here, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Sorry, I'm actually here to see Headmistress Durella.
say:7:1611399002:1.female: I didn't expect to see you here, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Sorry, I'm actually here to see Headmistress Durella.

narration:8:1611399003:1.text: 你将发生的事情告知娑丽丝<key:keyGender_dialog2>

say:9:1611399004:1.text: She's the headmistress! How could she endanger her students... and steal from you?
say:9:1611399004:1.source_cn: 杜瑞拉女士身为莱希拉姆的代理校长，却完全不把学校师生利...
say:9:1611399004:1.male: She's the headmistress! How could she endanger her students... and steal from you?
say:9:1611399004:1.female: She's the headmistress! How could she endanger her students... and steal from you?

say:10:1611399005:1.text: She is unfit to serve as headmistress.
say:10:1611399005:1.source_cn: 她这样的人……怎么能继承雷蒙校长的位置！
say:10:1611399005:1.male: She is unfit to serve as headmistress.
say:10:1611399005:1.female: She is unfit to serve as headmistress.

say:11:1611399006:1.text: I planned to bring the results of the speech loss case to her attention, but I can no longer trust her judgment.
say:11:1611399006:1.source_cn: 我本来是要找她报告失语症的后续情况的。但现在，我不认为...
say:11:1611399006:1.male: I planned to bring the results of the speech loss case to her attention, but I can no longer trust her judgment.
say:11:1611399006:1.female: I planned to bring the results of the speech loss case to her attention, but I can no longer trust her judgment.

say:13:1611399007:1.text: It strikes you that the speech loss cases all circle back to the magic contracts.
say:13:1611399007:1.source_cn: 你回忆起对失语症的调查，这种病症的出现本身就与魔力契约...
say:13:1611399007:1.male: It strikes you that the speech loss cases all circle back to the magic contracts.
say:13:1611399007:1.female: It strikes you that the speech loss cases all circle back to the magic contracts.

say:14:1611399008:1.text: A bigger pattern takes shape. Franz, Durella, Esten—none of them are the mastermind. Someone else is pulling the strings.
say:14:1611399008:1.source_cn: 但你也察觉到，无论是逃跑的弗朗茨，还是杜瑞拉或埃斯特，...
say:14:1611399008:1.male: A bigger pattern takes shape. Franz, Durella, Esten—none of them are the mastermind. Someone else is pulling the strings.
say:14:1611399008:1.female: A bigger pattern takes shape. Franz, Durella, Esten—none of them are the mastermind. Someone else is pulling the strings.

say:15:1611399009:1.text: Suddenly, you hear footsteps rush toward the headmaster's office.
say:15:1611399009:1.source_cn: 正在你思考之时，一阵慌乱的脚步声传来，有人在急匆匆地向...
say:15:1611399009:1.male: Suddenly, you hear footsteps rush toward the headmaster's office.
say:15:1611399009:1.female: Suddenly, you hear footsteps rush toward the headmaster's office.

say:16:1611399010:1.text: You shouldn't be seen here. You exchange a look with Solise and quietly step aside to hide.
say:16:1611399010:1.source_cn: 你并不想节外生枝，于是对娑丽丝打了个眼色，走到一边躲了起来。
say:16:1611399010:1.male: You shouldn't be seen here. You exchange a look with Solise and quietly step aside to hide.
say:16:1611399010:1.female: You shouldn't be seen here. You exchange a look with Solise and quietly step aside to hide.

say:19:1611399011:1.text: Professor Solise! Have you seen the headmistress?

say:20:1611399012:1.source_cn: 别慌，发生了什么事，直接告诉我就好。

say:22:1611399013:0.text: A Hypofiend... there's a Hypofiend in the <style="highlight">art gallery</style>!
say:22:1611399013:0.source_cn: 魔物，学校里出现了魔物！就在<style=highli...

say:23:1611399014:0.source_cn: 你来的时候有人受伤吗？

say:24:1611399015:0.text: Not yet. It hasn't attacked anyone. Silven's already evacuating students.
say:24:1611399015:0.source_cn: 没有，魔物暂时没有发动攻击，而且休已经在组织画廊里的同...

say:25:1611399016:0.text: I understand. Headmistress Durella isn't in her office. Go warn the other professors, I'm heading to the gallery now.
say:25:1611399016:0.source_cn: 我知道了……杜瑞拉女士有事不在，你先返回教学楼通知其他...

say:30:1611399018:1.text: Another Hypofiend? I should check it out.
say:30:1611399018:1.source_cn: 学校里又出现了魔物？！不行，我也得赶紧去艺术画廊！
say:30:1611399018:1.male: Another Hypofiend? I should check it out.
say:30:1611399018:1.female: Another Hypofiend? I should check it out.

narration:32:16011286:0.text: You knock Aurelian down and use his own spell against him.
narration:32:16011286:0.source_cn: 你将奥瑞利安击倒，并反向利用了他的术式。
narration:32:16011286:0.male: You knock Aurelian down and use his own spell against him.
narration:32:16011286:0.female: You knock Aurelian down and use his own spell against him.
